name: power-up-kit
description: Power-Up Kit — a web studio team inside Claude for web designers, developers, SEO teams and agencies. Unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic.

plugins.name: power-up-kit
plugins.description: Everything in Power-Up Kit in one install: client memory, proof checks, SEO audits, content briefs, meta and schema, redirect maps, monthly SEO reports, brand sheets, proposals and launch checks for web designers, developers, SEO teams and agencies.

plugins.name: powerup-core
plugins.description: Client memory (brand, voice, SEO, decisions), proof checks with screenshots and evidence, setup doctor, and safety hooks that protect secret files.

plugins.name: powerup-seo
plugins.description: SEO audits with a crawl, PageSpeed and a health score; content briefs built from what ranks; titles, meta and schema that pass checks; redirect maps for migrations; monthly client reports. Uses Search Console, Ahrefs or Semrush when connected.

plugins.name: powerup-design
plugins.description: Brand sheets from any website or brief: colours with contrast checks, fonts, logo, tone of voice — saved to the client's memory.

plugins.name: powerup-agency
plugins.description: Client proposals with real pricing in your branding, and a launch pipeline that catches go-live disasters (noindex, staging URLs, missing redirects, no analytics) and gets client sign-off.
